about: Query -> expected-note pairs for measuring `mb search` recall. Referenced by singularity/search/lexical.py as the reason BM25/RRF constants are not exposed as config: a change this set cannot justify should not be made.
ground_truth_method: Every target note was chosen FIRST, by reading what it is about; the query was then written the way a person would ask for it. No pair was derived from what the current ranking returns, so the set can report a bad number. Queries marked `harvested: true` are verbatim `mb search` invocations taken from real session transcripts.

classes.identifier: an exact token carries the query - identifier, flag, error name, API symbol. The class BM25 exists for.
classes.natural: a question in prose, same language as the note. The class embeddings are good at.
classes.crosslingual: query language differs from the note language. The claim the multilingual model exists for; never measured before this set.
